notes.content:
- fixed several text typos

- fixed objects disappearance
- added additional colliders for some walls

notes.title: Objects manipulation update
notes.content:
Thanks to your feedback about the game we've improved objects manipulation for PC and VR. Also navigation and collision related bugs were listed and fixed!

Grab-lock feature
We noticed that some of you liked the static mirrors rotation and got frustrated with the regular ones that you need constantly look at to manipulate. Well, not anymore because now we've added a grab-lock feature to effectively lock any object in place with a convenient additional button.
Go and try it yourself!

VR manipulation improvements
Thanks to several reports we debugged issues with objects manipulation in VR and fixed rotation logic. Now its more predictable and easier to use, especially in combination with the grab-lock.

Bugfixes
collected and fixed all collider related issues in the game

make crystals colors invulnerable to environment light and post processing effects to prevent color shift

fixed checkpoint issues

fixed environment changes not being saved in some cases after reload

additional minor bugfixes

notes.title: Steam Deck native support
notes.content:
We love handheld consoles! That's exactly why we've prepared a native SteamOS (Linux) build so you can take Echoes of the Sun with you wherever you go.
Additionally, that means, you can run the game natively on MacOS and numerous Linux distros.

The control map is based on Generic Gamepad.

In-Game controls

Movement - L Thumb 
Camera - R Thumb 
Jump - A
Grab - hold R2
Rotate - L1, R1 
Interact - X
Talk - X

Menu controls

Menu - Menu button
Navigation - L Thumb
Tabs Navigation - L1, R1
Submit - A
Cancel - B
Save Changes - Y
Reset - X

If you have any additional questions, feel free to write it the comments

notes.title: Animation Update in "Echoes of the Sun"
notes.content:
he world of "Echoes of the Sun" has become even more vibrant! We've updated the animations to make the little girl's journey through the ruins of her shattered world even more emotional and captivating.

Character movements are now smoother, and interactions with magical objects feel more natural. The use of telekinesis and manipulation of ancient stones now looks even more impressive, bringing each of your decisions to life on the screen.

These changes add even more depth to the gameplay and help you better experience the dramatic story of restoring the world. Get ready for new experiences as you embark on the journey to restore light and peace in your heart!
